land.label: Land, about 1.5 acres of CLB land with US 183 frontage
land.assumption: Carried at the full asking price of the one listed comparable, a 1.52-acre CLB tract with US 183 frontage inside city limits offered at $1,850,000 in October 2026 [^16]. It is an asking price, not a sale; no closed Lockhart land sale was found, so the study takes no discount.

store_sf.label: Store size, square feet
store_sf.assumption: Between Yesway's 3,400 sq ft legacy store and its 5,800 sq ft new-build average [^36], large enough for a made-to-order kitchen and a few seats.

building_psf.label: Store and canopy hard cost per square foot of store
building_psf.assumption: Inside the $150 to $350 contractor range for building and canopy [^39], in the upper half because nonresidential construction inputs rose 7.1% in the year to June 2026 [^41] and the store carries a kitchen.

tanks.label: Underground storage tanks
tanks.assumption: One tank each for regular, premium and diesel; a blending dispenser makes midgrade.

tank_cost.label: Installed cost per tank, complete with piping and monitoring
tank_cost.assumption: Midpoint of the $60,000 to $380,000 a fuel-system vendor gives for a complete installed tank system, updated August 18, 2026 [^40]; the same guide puts the vessel alone at $20,000 to $80,000.

dispensers.label: Multi-product dispensers (12 fueling positions)
dispensers.assumption: Six islands for a highway frontage; the contractor's all-in example runs 4 dispensers for 3,000 sq ft [^39] and Yesway's legacy stores average 10 [^36].

dispenser_cost.label: Cost per dispenser
dispenser_cost.assumption: Middle of the $25,000 to $75,000 per dispenser range in the same vendor's cost table [^40]; its text quotes a lower floor of $12,000, so the table is the safer reading.

sitework.label: Site work, paving, drainage, utility taps and signage
sitework.assumption: No Lockhart site-work cost was found and the city does not publish commercial impact fee amounts [^28]; carried as a round allowance for a 1.5-acre pad with two drives.

contingency_pct.label: Hard-cost contingency
contingency_pct.assumption: Five percent of building, tank and site costs, a common lender floor for a priced but unbid project.

soft.label: Design, permits, SUP process, survey, Phase I and legal
soft.assumption: Allowance; it includes a Phase I environmental site assessment, which gas station loans carry regardless of size [^43], and the cost of a Specific Use Permit application if the overlay is mapped.

ffe.label: Store fixtures, coolers, kitchen and point of sale
ffe.assumption: Allowance for a kitchen-equipped store; no published equipment share of cost was found.

fuel_inventory.label: Opening fuel inventory
fuel_inventory.assumption: Low half of the $100,000 to $300,000 initial fuel inventory range in Holiday's 2025 franchise disclosure, as relayed by a contractor [^42].

merch_inventory.label: Opening merchandise and food inventory
merch_inventory.assumption: Allowance for a store of this size; no Lockhart figure was found.

working_capital.label: Pre-opening payroll, training and working capital
working_capital.assumption: About two months of the modelled payroll and fixed costs before sales settle.

gallons_day.label: Fuel gallons sold per day
gallons_day.assumption: Ramps to the national average of about 4,000 gallons a day per store [^9] by Year 3: a new 12-position store on the main highway of a city growing 26.2% since 2020 [^1] should reach the average, but 16 in-town stations hold Lockhart's existing demand, so the study does not underwrite above it.

fuel_margin.label: Fuel gross margin per gallon
fuel_margin.assumption: Below the 39.7-cent 2024 national gasoline margin [^9] and well below the 35.1 to 52.6 cents listed operators earned in the second quarter of 2026, a level lifted by the 2026 supply shock [^38]; the H-E-B fuel center on US 183 [^15] anchors the low end of local prices.

inside_sales.label: Inside sales, merchandise and food
inside_sales.assumption: Year 3 sits between Yesway's $1.7 million legacy store and its $3.1 million new-build store [^36]; the kitchen and Lockhart's barbecue traffic justify more than a legacy store, but not a new-build chain store.

food_margin.label: Foodservice gross margin
food_margin.assumption: Below the 58.3% prepared food margin Casey's reported for the first nine months of its fiscal 2026 [^37]; an independent kitchen buys at smaller scale.

merch_margin.label: Merchandise gross margin
merch_margin.assumption: Below Yesway's 35.2% inside margin for 2025 [^36], which blends in its food; packaged goods alone earn less.

staff_shift.label: Staff on the floor per hour
staff_shift.assumption: Slightly under Yesway's portfolio average of 2.6 employees per shift [^36], whose stores average larger.

hours.label: Hours open per day
hours.assumption: Open around the clock like the two Valero stores on US 183 that list 24-hour service [^12,13].

burden.label: Payroll taxes and benefits on wages
burden.assumption: Employer payroll taxes, workers' compensation and limited benefits for hourly retail staff; no Texas c-store figure was found.

inflation.label: Annual growth in wages and operating costs
inflation.assumption: Near the 3.4% consumer price inflation reported for August 2026 [^38].

card_cpg.label: Card fees per gallon of fuel

utilities.label: Electricity, water and gas, Year 1
utilities.assumption: The city's General Service Demand tariff adds a purchased power cost set by Council in October 2007 whose current value the rate page does not show [^27], so the bill cannot be built from the tariff; carried as an allowance for a 24-hour store with a kitchen.

repairs.label: Repairs, supplies, tank testing and compliance, Year 1
repairs.assumption: Allowance; tank and line testing is part of the environmental file a gas station loan keeps [^43].

insurance.label: Property, liability and pollution insurance, Year 1
insurance.assumption: No Caldwell County premium was found; carried as an allowance and made a lender condition.

admin.label: Accounting, payroll service, licenses and permits, Year 1
admin.assumption: Allowance; the state license list for fuel, tobacco and alcohol sales was not found in the research.

tax_rate.label: Property tax rate: County, road, City, Lockhart ISD and two Plum Creek districts, 2025

reserve_pct.label: Replacement reserve, share of dispenser and fixture cost per year
reserve_pct.assumption: Funds dispenser, cooler and kitchen replacement over roughly a 20-year cycle.

uses.label: Land, about 1.5 acres on US 183
uses.basis: assumption at the listed comparable's ask [^16]

uses.label: Store and canopy, 4,200 sq ft
uses.basis: sq ft x cost per sq ft [^39,41]

uses.label: Site work, paving, utilities and signage
Design, permits, SUP, Phase I, legal
Fixtures, coolers, kitchen, point of sale

revenue.label: Fuel gross profit
revenue.basis: gallons a day x 365 x margin [^9,38]

revenue.label: Merchandise gross profit
revenue.basis: inside sales x non-food share x margin [^34,36]

revenue.label: Foodservice gross profit
revenue.basis: inside sales x food share x margin [^34,37]

opex.label: Store payroll and burden
opex.expr: staff_shift * hours * 365 * wage * (1 + burden) * (1 + inflation) ** y

opex.label: Property tax
opex.expr: (land + store_sf * building_psf + tanks * tank_cost + sitework + dispensers * dispenser_cost + ffe) * tax_rate
